en: Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph of a large late‑19th‑century institutional building with three stories, a mansardlike roof, and a small onion-shaped dome at the center above a clock. The façade is symmetrical with many tall rectangular windows, rusticated stone on the ground floor, and smoother plastered upper stories. In front runs an unpaved road with a simple wooden railing; logs lie beside a drainage ditch in the foreground. Leafless trees and wooden fencing partly obscure the right side of the building. There is no visible printed caption or handwritten text on the image.
